label: Genre
description: Genre flavor injected across any subject. Items tag themselves so genre-filtered slots can couple with matching locations.

items.name: science-fiction
items.text: hard science-fiction aesthetic, functional technology, believable near-future materials

items.name: cyberpunk
items.text: cyberpunk aesthetic, high tech low life, neon on grime, chrome and rain

items.name: steampunk
items.text: steampunk aesthetic, brass gauges, riveted copper, steam and Victorian machinery

items.name: solarpunk
items.text: solarpunk aesthetic, verdant optimistic future, plants woven through bright clean architecture

items.name: high-fantasy
items.text: high-fantasy aesthetic, mythic scale, enchanted materials and heraldic detail

items.name: dark-fantasy
items.text: dark-fantasy aesthetic, gothic dread, corrupted beauty and candlelit shadow

items.name: film-noir
items.text: film-noir aesthetic, venetian-blind shadows, cigarette haze and fatal glamour

items.name: western
items.text: western aesthetic, sun-bleached dust, worn leather and long horizons

items.name: gothic-horror
items.text: gothic-horror atmosphere, decayed grandeur, fog and wrought iron under a cold moon

items.name: retro-futurism
items.text: retro-futurist aesthetic, atomic-age optimism, chrome fins and raygun curves

items.name: post-apocalyptic
items.text: post-apocalyptic aesthetic, reclaimed ruins, improvised gear and beautiful decay

items.name: cosmic-horror
items.text: cosmic-horror atmosphere, wrong geometry, scale beyond comprehension, dread in the vastness

items.name: fairy-tale
items.text: storybook fairy-tale aesthetic, gentle wonder, cottages and deep friendly woods

items.name: mythological
items.text: classical mythological aesthetic, marble, laurels, gods and golden ratio grandeur

items.name: space-opera
items.text: space-opera aesthetic, vast fleets, glowing nebulae and operatic galactic scale

items.name: dieselpunk
items.text: dieselpunk aesthetic, interwar machine age, riveted steel and oiled brass, roaring prop engines over smog-stained deco cities

items.name: afrofuturism
items.text: afrofuturist aesthetic, gleaming chrome fused with kente geometry and beadwork, regal silhouettes against orbital skylines
